forbidden.name: domain-isolation
forbidden.comment: domain/ imports nothing outside domain/: no framework, no application or adapter code.

forbidden.name: application-no-adapter
forbidden.comment: Application depends only on the domain and its own ports; adapters depend on it.

forbidden.name: application-no-composition
forbidden.comment: Application never imports the modules or the bootstrap that wire it.

forbidden.name: application-no-transport
forbidden.comment: Validation, HTTP, and the OpenAPI document belong to adapter/web.
